summary: Selfoss is a web-based feed reader and content aggregation application designed to pull multiple information streams into a single interface. It functions as a self-hosted platform to collect and manage syndicated feeds and live data sources. The project is licensed under the GPL-3.0 and implemented in PHP.
goodFor: It suits users looking for a traditional, self-hosted RSS aggregation tool running on standard PHP infrastructure without heavy resource demands.
watchOut: The maintenance velocity has slowed over time, which may lead to compatibility issues with newer PHP versions or web standards.
deployNotes: You will typically need a standard web server like Apache or Nginx with a PHP runtime, alongside a compatible database backend for data persistence and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
